test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A dishonest dealer professes to sell his goods at cost price but uses a false weight of 950 grams instead of 1 kilogram. His gain percentage is:
solution:
**Given:**

A dishonest dealer uses a false weight of 950 grams instead of 1 kilogram (1000 grams) and claims to sell at cost price.

**Formula Used:**

Gain Percentage, G% = ((True weight - False weight) / False weight) × 100

**Calculation:**

True weight = 1000 grams

False weight = 950 grams

Gain = True weight - False weight

Gain = 1000 - 950 = 50 grams

G% = (50 / 950) × 100

G% = (50 × 100) / 950

G% = 5000 / 950 = 100/19

G% = 5(5)/(19)%

**The gain percentage is **5(5)/(19) **%.**
